# Michael Castilla

> GTM Engineer based in Miami, FL with 15+ years of experience leading product teams and building internal tools and consumer applications across SaaS, media, and eCommerce.

Michael Castilla is an award-winning product management and software engineering professional. He specializes in product operations — a streamlined customer validation process powered by lightweight design systems and agile-inspired development practices. He has shipped work for SiriusXM, Pandora, QuickNode, Apple, Polo Ralph Lauren, Norwegian Cruise Line, and others.

## Portfolio

- [StableTerm](https://michaelcastilla.com/portfolio/stableterm): AI-powered terminal for blockchain developers
- [QuickNode](https://michaelcastilla.com/portfolio/quicknode): Developer platform for blockchain infrastructure
- [Back to You](https://michaelcastilla.com/portfolio/back-to-you): Apple TV+ promotional experience
